title: Pro-Cap: Leveraging a Frozen Vision-Language Model for Hateful Meme Detection
findings: The study found that prompting vision-language models with specific, targeted questions about religion (e.g., 'What is the religion of the person in the image?') generates more informative image captions. These captions, containing explicit religious identifiers like 'muslim' or 'christian', significantly improve the performance of downstream models in detecting religiously hateful memes, outperforming methods that rely on generic image captions which often miss this crucial context.
